# Version 4.152.1 (Unreleased)
> **GlyphData stability fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.1 backports an upstream GlyphData rendering fix to the servicing line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Glyph atlas updates corrected** — The bundled Skia engine no longer treats partial glyph-vector updates as complete atlas generations, avoiding stale glyph locations after eviction in Ganesh and Graphite rendering. ([#5047](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5047))
